reviews.reviewbody:
Original source (c. 150 CE) in 1843 edition (excellent condition),

thanks, for this publication in original language (Ancient greek). Indeed of value as Geōgraphikḕ Hyphḗgēsis is mostly distributed in Roman/English versions. Very valuable for us in Scandinavia, as Ptolemy is only the second source (after Tacitus 98 CE) that mentions Φίννοι Phinnoi/Fenni which can be considered to relate to the Sámi - the indigenous people of Fennoscandia. 

Thanks again.
